caveats: Euro and several other currencies are absent in earlier years; those months are missing rows, not zeros.

CBSL makes the workbook freely downloadable but does not state an open-data reuse licence on the statistical-table page; this artifact contains normalized aggregate facts and does not redistribute the workbook.
description: Monthly average and month-end Sri Lanka rupee rates against published foreign currencies, from Central Bank of Sri Lanka exchange-rate workbooks.
grain: One row per month, currency and rate kind.
notes: Rates are Sri Lanka rupees per one unit of foreign currency, except JPY which is also quoted per yen.
USD, GBP, EUR, AUD and CAD are rounded to four decimal places; SDR and JPY to six, matching the workbooks’ typical published precision.
A source dash is omitted rather than stored as zero.
title: Monthly exchange rates
